余元山闻言，眉头紧锁，脸上露出了为难的神色。他虽然知道龙虎山有禁咒，却不知道禁咒还有如此严重的反噬之力。

他沉默了片刻，缓缓说道：

“我明白你的顾虑，反噬之事，确实棘手。但你想想，若是不破解聚阴阵，后果不堪设想，比起整个世界的安危，个人的得失，又算得了什么？”

胡九郎摇了摇头，语气依旧坚定，说道：“可是局长，这个禁咒需要别人配合，我不能拿别人的性命冒险。”

余元山看着他，心中暗自叹息，轻声说道：

“我知道你很难抉择，我也不逼你。”

余元山转身朝着正房走去，留下胡九郎一个人站在庭院的角落，神色复杂，满心纠结。

胡九郎抬头望向夜空，月光黯淡，夜色深沉，就像他此刻的心情。

他知道余元山说的是对的，破解聚阴阵，是当前唯一的希望，可他又真的不敢催动禁咒，他怕自己出事，更怕牵连到别人。

这让他陷入了两难的境地，不知道该如何抉择。

余元山走进正房时，杨童已经看完了关于夏未来的所有资料，正皱着眉头，和杨树远、李二牛等人讨论着聚阴阵的破解之法。

看到余元山进来，众人纷纷停下交谈，目光落在他身上，眼中满是期待，希望他能想出破解聚阴阵的办法。

杨童率先开口，语气急切地说道：

“局长，资料我都看完了，我们必须尽快破解聚阴阵，我们根本找不到破解之法，您有什么办法吗？”

余元山走到石桌旁，坐了下来，神色凝重地说道：

“夏未来的野心远比我们想象的还要大。这聚阴阵确实诡异无比，普通的术法和符箓，根本无法破解。不过，我倒是知道一个办法，能够彻底破解这聚阴阵。”

众人闻言，纷纷眼前一亮，李二牛连忙说道：

“局长，什么办法？您快说，只要能破解聚阴阵，我们就算拼尽全力，也一定会做到！”

余元山的目光落在杨童身上，缓缓说道：

“破解聚阴阵的方法，就在胡九郎身上。他是龙虎山的弟子，龙虎山有一个禁咒，能够彻底消融阴邪之气，破解一切阴邪阵法，只要他催动这个禁咒，就能破解聚阴阵，我们就能找到上古邪物的踪迹，阻止夏未来的阴谋。”

杨童闻言，眼中闪过一丝惊喜，连忙说道：

“真的吗？九郎竟然有办法破解聚阴阵？那太好了，我现在就去叫他进来，让他催动禁咒！”

余元山连忙叫住她，神色有些为难地说道：

“等等，事情没有那么简单。这个禁咒虽然威力极大，但做起来难度极大，过程十分凶险，胡九郎担心自己无法成功，还担心会出现意外，所以一直不愿意答应。”

他刻意隐瞒了禁咒的反噬之力，没有告诉杨童，催动禁咒不仅会让胡九郎身受重创，还会牵连到与他相匹配的人。

他知道若是告诉杨童真相，以杨童的性子，必定会更加犹豫，甚至可能会阻止胡九郎，到时候就再也没有破解聚阴阵的希望了。

杨童闻言，脸上的惊喜渐渐消散，取而代之的是一丝担忧。她了解胡九郎，他从来都不是胆小怕事的人，若是真的有办法破解聚阴阵，他一定会答应，除非这件事真的太过凶险，让他也产生了顾虑。

When Yu Yuanshan heard this, his brows furrowed and a troubled look appeared on his face.Although he knew that there was a forbidden curse in Longhu Mountain, he didn't know that the forbidden curse had such serious backlash.

He was silent for a moment and said slowly:

"I understand your concerns. The backlash is indeed difficult. But think about it, if you don't crack the Yin Gathering Formation, the consequences will be disastrous. Compared with the safety of the entire world, what are personal gains and losses?"

Hu Jiulang shook his head, his tone still firm, and said: "But Director, this forbidden spell requires the cooperation of others, and I can't risk other people's lives."

Yu Yuanshan looked at him, sighed secretly in his heart, and said softly:

"I know it's hard for you to make a choice, and I won't force you."

Yu Yuanshan turned and walked towards the main room, leaving Hu Jiulang standing alone in the corner of the courtyard with a complicated expression and full of tangles.

Hu Jiulang looked up at the night sky. The moonlight was dim and the night was dark, just like his mood at the moment.

He knew that what Yu Yuanshan said was right. Breaking the Yin Gathering Formation was the only hope at the moment, but he really didn't dare to activate the forbidden spell. He was afraid that something would happen to him, and he was even more afraid of implicating others.

This put him in a dilemma, not knowing how to choose.

When Yu Yuanshan walked into the main room, Yang Tong had already read all the information about Xia Future and was frowning, discussing with Yang Shuyuan, Li Erniu and others how to crack the Yin Gathering Formation.

Seeing Yu Yuanshan come in, everyone stopped talking and their eyes fell on him, their eyes full of expectation, hoping that he could figure out a way to break the Yin Gathering Formation.

Yang Tong spoke first and said eagerly:

"Director, I have read all the information. We must crack the Yin Gathering Formation as soon as possible. We can't find a way to crack it at all. Do you have any ideas?"

Yu Yuanshan walked to the stone table, sat down, and said solemnly:

"Xia Future's ambitions are far greater than we imagined. This Yin Gathering Formation is really weird, and ordinary spells and talismans cannot be broken. However, I do know a way to completely break this Yin Gathering Formation."

When everyone heard this, their eyes lit up, and Li Erniu said quickly:

"Director, what can we do? Tell me quickly, as long as we can break the Yin Gathering Formation, we will definitely do it even if we try our best!"

Yu Yuanshan's eyes fell on Yang Tong and said slowly:

"The way to crack the Yin Gathering Formation lies with Hu Jiulang. He is a disciple of Longhu Mountain. There is a forbidden spell in Longhu Mountain that can completely dissolve the evil spirit and break all Yin Evil Formations. As long as he activates this forbidden spell, he can break the Yin Gathering Formation, and we can find traces of ancient evil objects and stop Xia Future's conspiracy."

When Yang Tong heard this, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes, and he said quickly:

"Really? Jiulang actually has a way to break the Yin Gathering Formation? That's great, I'll call him in now and let him activate the forbidden curse!"

Yu Yuanshan quickly stopped her and said with a somewhat embarrassed look:

"Wait a minute, things are not that simple. Although this forbidden spell is extremely powerful, it is extremely difficult to perform and the process is very dangerous. Hu Jiulang was worried that he would not be able to succeed and that there would be an accident, so he has been unwilling to agree."

He deliberately concealed the counterattack power of the forbidden curse and did not tell Yang Tong that activating the forbidden curse would not only cause Hu Jiulang to be severely injured, but would also implicate people who matched him.

He knew that if he told Yang Tong the truth, given Yang Tong's temperament, he would definitely be more hesitant and might even stop Hu Jiulang. Then there would be no hope of breaking the Yin Gathering Formation.

When Yang Tong heard this, the surprise on his face gradually dissipated and was replaced by a trace of worry.She knew Hu Jiulang. He had never been a timid person. If there was really a way to break the Yin Gathering Formation, he would definitely agree, unless this matter was really too dangerous and made him worry.
